index_space: Original body.data.vertices indices, corresponding to exported _SOURCE_INDEX; not evaluated/subdivision indices.
coordinate_frame: Blender world metres; exported Three.js conversion [x,z,-y].

pelvic_support_L.rationale: Posterior left pelvic skin quad, selected from the actual low support-facing surface in the accepted side/oblique pose. Not an atlas glute mask or a clinically identified ischial landmark.

pelvic_support_R.rationale: Mirrored posterior right pelvic skin quad; same floor and authored soft-tissue support interpretation as left.

heel_L.rationale: Original plantar heel vertices; rest-space posterior heel and low sole surface, not the entire Foot group.

sole_L.rationale: Original plantar forefoot/sole patch; separated from heel to verify a shared planted foot plane.

palm_L.rationale: Source palm face-set surface, including its boundary; evaluated against head/ear triangles, not wrist-to-head joint distance.

fingertips_L.rationale: Distal source skin vertices on four fingers, near the posterior scalp; thumb is included in whole-hand clearance, not required to touch.

hand_L.rationale: All strongly hand/finger-bound source vertices for scalp and ear penetration detection.

heel_R.rationale: Original plantar heel vertices; rest-space posterior heel and low sole surface, not the entire Foot group.

sole_R.rationale: Original plantar forefoot/sole patch; separated from heel to verify a shared planted foot plane.

palm_R.rationale: Source palm face-set surface, including its boundary; evaluated against head/ear triangles, not wrist-to-head joint distance.

fingertips_R.rationale: Distal source skin vertices on four fingers, near the posterior scalp; thumb is included in whole-hand clearance, not required to touch.

hand_R.rationale: All strongly hand/finger-bound source vertices for scalp and ear penetration detection.

lumbar_clearance.rationale: Posterior lumbar skin strip: verifies lowering pelvis did not push the lower back through the floor.

head_surface.rationale: Original head and ears above the jaw/upper-neck boundary; triangles support signed closest-surface hand clearance checks.

tolerance_basis: Authored illustration QA at 1.8m character scale and 768px review framing; millimetre clearance/contact bands account for curved soft skin and cage/native interpolation. Not medical landmarks, physiological limits, or biomechanics approval. Values are declared before reading this candidate report. A 3mm opposing-hand lateral separation explicitly prevents the actual fingertip-to-fingertip coplanar errors found in the native gate; it is an authoring requirement for this non-interlaced hand pose, not a universal movement limit.
issue_closure: Primary review required; contract issues remain open.
